title: PostgreSQL
tagline: Design, query, secure, and operate reliable relational databases
summary: A practical PostgreSQL textbook covering relational modeling, SQL queries, transactions and concurrency, index design, query plans, vacuum, JSONB, security, migrations, backups, replication, partitioning, pooling, observability, and production operations. Lessons combine runnable SQL, design reasoning, failure modes, and hands-on checkpoints.
